```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Read Small Areas
# ---------------------------------------------------------

sa <- st_read("../data/Small_Area_National_Statistical_Boundaries_2022.geojson", quiet = TRUE)

id_candidates <- c("GEOGID", "SA_GUID", "SAID", "SA_ID", "SMALL_AREA", "OBJECTID", "FID")
sa_id <- id_candidates[id_candidates %in% names(sa)][1]

if (is.na(sa_id)) {
  sa <- sa %>% mutate(sa_uid = row_number())
  sa_id <- "sa_uid"
}

# Same CRS as kriging data
sa <- sa %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(dat_irl$region_sf))


# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Function: create 3 x 3 prediction points inside each Small Area
# ---------------------------------------------------------

make_sa_3x3_points <- function(sa, sa_id, n_side = 3) {
  
  sa <- st_make_valid(sa)
  
  pts_all <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(sa)), function(i) {
    
    poly <- sa[i, ]
    
    # Create 3 x 3 grid over this Small Area bounding box
    g <- st_make_grid(
      poly,
      n = c(n_side, n_side),
      what = "polygons"
    )
    
    g <- st_sf(
      local_cell_id = seq_along(g),
      geometry = g,
      crs = st_crs(sa)
    )
    
    # Clip the 3 x 3 cells to the actual Small Area polygon
    clipped <- suppressWarnings(
      st_intersection(
        g,
        poly %>% select(all_of(sa_id))
      )
    )
    
    clipped <- clipped %>%
      st_make_valid() %>%
      filter(!st_is_empty(geometry)) %>%
      mutate(area_w = as.numeric(st_area(geometry))) %>%
      filter(area_w > 0)
    
    if (nrow(clipped) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    # One guaranteed-inside point per clipped grid cell
    pts <- st_point_on_surface(clipped)
    
    pts %>%
      mutate(
        sa_sample_id = paste0(.data[[sa_id]], "_", local_cell_id)
      )
  })
  
  pts_all %>%
    mutate(sample_row = row_number())
}


sa_3x3_pts_sf <- make_sa_3x3_points(
  sa = sa,
  sa_id = sa_id,
  n_side = 3
)

sa_3x3_pts_sp <- as(sa_3x3_pts_sf, "Spatial")
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Krige directly at the 3 x 3 points inside each Small Area
# ---------------------------------------------------------

run_sa_3x3_kriging <- function(
  schools_agg_sp,
  prediction_points_sf,
  prediction_points_sp,
  sa,
  sa_id,
  width,
  cutoff,
  vgm_start,
  nmax = 150,
  nmin = 1,
  maxdist = 1e6
) {
  
  # Empirical variogram
  v <- variogram(
    log_enrol ~ 1,
    data = schools_agg_sp,
    width = width,
    cutoff = cutoff
  )
  
  # Fit variogram model
  fv <- fit.variogram(v, vgm_start)
  
  # Ordinary kriging at the 3 x 3 Small Area points
  kriged_sp <- krige(
    log_enrol ~ 1,
    locations = schools_agg_sp,
    newdata   = prediction_points_sp,
    model     = fv,
    nmax      = nmax,
    nmin      = nmin,
    maxdist   = maxdist
  )
  
  kriged_sf <- st_as_sf(kriged_sp)
  
  # Reattach Small Area metadata
  kriged_sf <- kriged_sf %>%
    mutate(
      !!sa_id := prediction_points_sf[[sa_id]],
      local_cell_id = prediction_points_sf$local_cell_id,
      sa_sample_id = prediction_points_sf$sa_sample_id,
      area_w = prediction_points_sf$area_w,
      enrol_pred = exp(var1.pred)
    )
  
  # Aggregate the 3 x 3 predictions back to one value per Small Area
  sa_agg <- kriged_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(.data[[sa_id]]) %>%
    summarise(
      krig_value = weighted.mean(enrol_pred, area_w, na.rm = TRUE),
      krig_var   = weighted.mean(var1.var, area_w, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_samples  = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  sa_with_krig <- sa %>%
    left_join(sa_agg, by = sa_id)
  
  list(
    variogram = v,
    variogram_model = fv,
    kriged_points_sf = kriged_sf,
    sa_with_krig = sa_with_krig
  )
}


res_sa <- run_sa_3x3_kriging(
  schools_agg_sp       = dat_irl$schools_agg_sp,
  prediction_points_sf = sa_3x3_pts_sf,
  prediction_points_sp = sa_3x3_pts_sp,
  sa                   = sa,
  sa_id                = sa_id,
  width  = 5000,
  cutoff = 200000,
  vgm_start = gstat::vgm(
    psill = 0.8,
    model = "Exp",
    range = 80000,
    nugget = 0.1
  ),
  nmax = 150
)
```
```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Normalise kriging by population aged 3-18
# ---------------------------------------------------------

to_num <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(as.numeric(x))
  readr::parse_number(as.character(x))
}

# Read SAPS age data
age_df <- read_csv("../data/SAPS_2022_Small_Area_UR_171024.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    GEOGID = str_trim(as.character(GEOGID)),
    SA_PUB2022 = GEOGID
  )

# Columns for exact ages 3 to 18
target_ages <- 3:18
target_cols <- paste0("T1_1AGE", target_ages, "T")

missing_age_cols <- setdiff(target_cols, names(age_df))

if (length(missing_age_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing age columns in SAPS file: ",
    paste(missing_age_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Match Small Area ID between kriging output and SAPS
age_id_candidates <- c(sa_id, "SA_PUB2022", "GEOGID")
age_id <- age_id_candidates[age_id_candidates %in% names(age_df)][1]

if (is.na(age_id)) {
  stop("No matching Small Area ID found between kriging data and SAPS data.")
}

# Compute real population aged 3-18 per Small Area
age_target <- age_df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(target_cols), to_num)) %>%
  transmute(
    join_id = str_trim(as.character(.data[[age_id]])),
    pop_3_18 = rowSums(across(all_of(target_cols)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  distinct(join_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Add normalised kriging variables
res_sa$sa_with_krig <- res_sa$sa_with_krig %>%
  mutate(
    join_id = str_trim(as.character(.data[[sa_id]]))
  ) %>%
  left_join(age_target, by = "join_id") %>%
  st_transform(2157) %>%
  mutate(
    area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6,

    # Kriging value per km²
    places_density_km2 = krig_value / area_km2,

    # Normalised by actual population aged 3-18
    krig_density_per_child_3_18 = if_else(
      is.finite(pop_3_18) & pop_3_18 > 0,
      places_density_km2 / pop_3_18,
      NA_real_
    ),

    # More interpretable version
    krig_density_per_1000_3_18 = 1000 * krig_density_per_child_3_18,

    # Scaled version for modelling
    krig_density_per_1000_3_18_z =
      as.numeric(scale(krig_density_per_1000_3_18))
  ) %>%
  select(-join_id)

# Quick check
res_sa$sa_with_krig %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  summarise(
    n_small_areas = n(),
    missing_krig = sum(is.na(krig_value)),
    missing_pop_3_18 = sum(is.na(pop_3_18)),
    zero_pop_3_18 = sum(pop_3_18 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_pop_3_18 = min(pop_3_18, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_pop_3_18 = max(pop_3_18, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_krig_norm = min(krig_density_per_1000_3_18, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_krig_norm = max(krig_density_per_1000_3_18, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```


```{r}
ggplot(res_sa$sa_with_krig |> st_drop_geometry(), aes(x = krig_value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of kriging values by Small Area",
    subtitle = "Each Small Area estimated from a 3 x 3 internal prediction grid",

  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Leaflet map
# ---------------------------------------------------------

sa_map <- res_sa$sa_with_krig %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  mutate(
    popup_text = paste0(
      "<b>Small Area ID:</b> ", .data[[sa_id]], "<br>",
      "<b>Predicted enrolment:</b> ", round(krig_value, 1), "<br>",
      "<b>Kriging variance:</b> ", round(krig_var, 3), "<br>",
      "<b>Prediction points used:</b> ", n_samples
    )
  )

ireland_map <- dat_irl$region_sf %>%
  st_transform(4326)

pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = viridis::viridis(256),
  domain = sa_map$krig_value[is.finite(sa_map$krig_value)],
  na.color = "transparent"
)

leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = sa_map,
    fillColor = ~pal(krig_value),
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    color = "white",
    weight = 0.2,
    popup = ~popup_text
  ) %>%
  addPolygons(
    data = ireland_map,
    fill = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    weight = 1
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    pal = pal,
    values = sa_map$krig_value,
    title = "Predicted enrolment",
    opacity = 0.8
  )
```

```{r}
library(sf)

# Folder to save outputs

# Small Areas with kriging values

  st_transform(4326) %>%
  mutate(
    popup_text = paste0(
      "<b>Small Area ID:</b> ", .data[[sa_id]], "<br>",
      "<b>Predicted enrolment:</b> ", round(krig_value, 1), "<br>",
      "<b>Kriging variance:</b> ", round(krig_var, 3), "<br>",
      "<b>Prediction points used:</b> ", n_samples
    )
  )

# Ireland boundary
ireland_map <- dat_irl$region_sf %>%
  st_transform(4326)

# Save everything needed for the Quarto slide
kriging_map_objects <- list(
  sa_map = sa_map,
  ireland_map = ireland_map,
  sa_id = sa_id
)

saveRDS(
  kriging_map_objects,
  file = "outputs/kriging_map_objects.rds"
)
```
